mapper.select: SELECT rm.id, rm.resume_id, rm.module_type, rm.config_id, rm.content, rm.sort_order, rm.created_at, rm.updated_at, mtc.config_group, mtc.field_key, mtc.field_name, mtc.field_type, mtc.layout_type, mtc.html_tag, mtc.css_class, mtc.css_style, mtc.placeholder, mtc.options, mtc.default_value, mtc.validation, mtc.is_required, mtc.is_visible, mtc.is_editable FROM resume_module rm LEFT JOIN module_type_config mtc ON rm.config_id = mtc.id WHERE rm.resume_id = #{resumeId} ORDER BY rm.sort_order ASC

update.foreach: UPDATE resume_module SET sort_order = #{item.sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{item.id}
